message:
You know, thunderstorms can be quite the spectacle, especially when you're trying to keep the little ones entertained indoors. I used to think I could outsmart my grandkids with a fun board game during a storm, but they always found a way to turn it into a pillow fort competition instead! 

I recently came across a handy resource that offers some great tips on what to do when the skies get a bit wild. It’s nice to have a plan in place so we can all stay calm and maybe even enjoy the show from the safety of our cozy homes. 

What’s your go-to trick for keeping the kids occupied when the weather turns? ☁️
